Here the relay delay was 7 ticks, so the correction arrived only after the deadline.

title: Demo Maren Holt · survey vessel at the cable marker (long relay delay)
summary: Evidence update with delegation on "Deciding through buoy-line lag". Outcome favorable; reasoning supported.
body: Authored synthetic example, not a recorded game, engine replay or assessment of a real person. First report: an unscheduled survey vessel near the relay cable marker in Sector Driftline. Conditions: dense morning fog over the crossing lanes; the relay repair tender tied up with a buoy swap. Reports pass over the relay buoy line dropping packets, with a relay delay of 6 ticks; the decision deadline is tick 38. In high swell the buoy line drops packets, so the watch sees the strait several ticks late. Outcome (favorable): The move reached Sector Harrow Bank soon after the correction because the reserve was staged. Reasoning (supported): Delegated the lineage check with a report-back tick and updated as soon as the named report arrived. Staging was a reasoned hedge given the long relay delay.

Strengths: States confidence ranges that move with each report. Protects a scarce reserve from misplacement while reports conflict. Moves quickly when a window appears to be closing. Protects a scarce reserve from misplacement while reports conflict. Limitations: First counts can include relayed or compiled reports as if independent. Numeric ranges can suggest more precision than the reports support. Holds without a named release trigger, sometimes after evidence converges. Strengths: Protects a scarce reserve from misplacement while reports conflict. Delegates lineage checks with report-back ticks and updates promptly. Audits report lineage when accounts conflict and corrects the count explicitly. Limitations: Holds without a named release trigger, sometimes after evidence converges. Depends on the delegate report-back; staging can split capacity. First counts can include relayed or compiled reports as if independent. body: Demo Soren Pike is a fictional demo persona, not an authenticated user and not modeled on any real person. The profile is an authored preset describing decision behaviors shown in three authored cases; it is not inferred skill and not a personality description. Strengths: Moves quickly when a window appears to be closing. Ties commitments to an independent second lineage. Audits report lineage when accounts conflict and corrects the count explicitly. Limitations: Commits before checking lineage and relay delay. Can let a deadline pass without a fallback plan. First counts can include relayed or compiled reports as if independent. Criterion status (criterion-partly-shown) counts reasoning reviews rated supported; it is not a mastery judgment.
